codeVersion.description: Working tree with uncommitted changes; commit is a reference only

checks: Both receipt widths keep long descriptions bounded and expose print action without broken width navigation
Receipt escapes stored text and distinguishes service professional from collector
Stored received cash and change are printed without claiming a CFDI or a scannable fake barcode
Receipt route uses private non-cached policy and permits its own inline print action
Anonymous and foreign business cannot read the thermal receipt
Ticket time is expressed in the branch time zone
